source_limitations: Actions are from original 1900 OCR observations, whose scanned printed pages were not visually checked. Pairwise comparisons to pre-existing labels support descriptive family, local variant, different sacred object, related phase, and non-equivalence only. They do NOT prove original eyewitness source independence, uninterrupted modern practice, ritual permission or distinct global custom identities. Same Pitrè 1900 edition cannot be independent corroboration of itself. Later Salemi sources represent OTHER municipalities from 1900 Ribera and Santa Croce.
